info.name: SkoolWala Complete API Collection
info.description: Complete collection of all SkoolWala APIs for backend and frontend testing

request.description: Generic authentication endpoint for all user types

Get side menu/navigation menu items based on user role and permissions. Returns hierarchical menu structure with icons, routes, and permissions. Can be called with session (if logged in) or with username/password for stateless authentication.
Get today's attendance for a staff member
Get count of present days for teacher
Get count of absent days for teacher
Get monthly present count for teacher for a year (returns count for each month)
Get monthly absent count for teacher for a year (returns count for each month)
Get or set student attendance. Use action='get' to retrieve attendance or action='save' to save attendance data
Mark staff attendance using QR code. in_out_time can be 'in_time' or 'out_time'
Mark teacher attendance using face recognition
Enroll face embedding for staff member
Check if face is enrolled for staff
Get list of all school locations
Check if coordinates are within school location

Get side menu/navigation menu items based on user role and permissions. IMPORTANT: This API automatically detects user role from login credentials (username/password) or session. The menu items are filtered based on:
- User role (Admin=1,2, Teacher=3, Accountant=4, Librarian=5, etc.)
- Role permissions (get_permission checks)
- Branch access

For stateless authentication: Send username and password in request body.
For session-based: Ensure you're logged in via session (cookies).

The API returns menu items matching the web version's sidebar menu based on user permissions. Response includes 'debug' object with role_id and permission checks.
Get all classes assigned to teacher
Get upcoming classes within specified minutes
